Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick next step to schedule a demo

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood Inference. We're excited to show you how to get predictable low-latency inference in your stack.

If you want a short technical walk-through, pick a 30-minute slot that works for you here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min — the calendar shows my current availability and will include an engineer if you'd like.

A few quick resources while you pick a time:
- redwood-quickstart.pdf (attached) — quick self-serve checklist and examples
- If you prefer mornings (PT), reply with "morning" and we'll prioritize those windows.

If you'd rather jump straight into a proof-of-concept, let me know your expected concurrency and preferred cloud region and I can loop in an AE.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: redwood-quickstart.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Thanks, Tessa — appreciate the quick note.

I grabbed a 9:30am PT slot on Friday via the Calendly link. Meeting title showed as "Redwood quick technical walk-through."

Couple of context items so you and the AE have the right expectations:
- We're evaluating inference options for a feature that will serve ~120 qps average, spiking to 400 qps for 10-15 minutes.
- Primary models will be 7B and 13B variants.
- We care a lot about cost per token and cold-start latency.

See you on Friday — Jordan

Jordan, here's the calendar invite link — please accept if you haven't already: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
